notes:
- 新增 Windows 应用内更新：后台自动检查、更新提示、下载进度和确认后重启安装；支持关闭自动检查。公开分发仓库只保存安装包及清单，无需客户端 GitHub 令牌。
- Add Windows in-app updates with automatic background checks, availability notices, download progress, restart consent, and an opt-out. A public distribution-only repository serves installers and manifests without client GitHub tokens.
- 更新包使用带版本绑定的签名校验；安装前阻止并发同步/AI 操作、沿用临时会话退出清理，并备份校验已关闭的资料库，保持原安装目录。旧版需手动升级一次；macOS/Linux 暂不接入更新。
- Verify version-bound update signatures; before installation, block conflicting sync/AI work, retain normal temporary-thread cleanup, and back up the closed vault while preserving the installation directory. Older versions require one manual upgrade; macOS/Linux updates remain out of scope.

- 修复 Windows 发版脚本续传时未展开 GitHub Release 数组、可能创建重复草稿的问题；增加离线 PowerShell 回归测试，统一使用 HTTP/1.1 发布传输。此维护修复不改变 v0.6.6 安装包。
- Fix release-page array handling that could create duplicate drafts during Windows release resumption. Add offline PowerShell regression coverage and use HTTP/1.1 for publishing. This maintenance fix does not change the v0.6.6 installer.
